newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean industrials weaker on giants' losses.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean industrials weaker on giants' losses.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index closed weaker on Wednesday, buckled down by losses in a couple of heavy-weight counters, brokers said.
"Today the gains and losses were fairly mixed on the whole, but the index fell on the back of losses in giants Delta and (clothing retailer) Edgars," commented one broker.
The index shed 24.31 points to 10,042.25, with Delta down 15 cents to 1,710 while Edgars put off 50 cents to 700.
Other counters to weaken included food and wine group Cairns, which lost 250 cents to 1,350, tyre firm NTS, down 40 to 310 cents and wine makers Afdis which eased 30 cents to 470.
On the up-side were hotel group Meikles which added 80 cents to 2,500, clothing retailers Truworths, which gained 100 cents to 900 and pharmaceutical company Caps 225 cents firmer at 2,750.
Minings continued quiet with the only gain of the day recorded in coal giant Wankie which put on five cents to 560, nudging the secondary index 1.82 points up 1,010.87.
